commands.text: Water has reached the edge of the linen book. A dark line climbs the page without asking where the writing ends.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Lift the cover. Not the wet corner.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: And leave the passage clear. Someone is coming through with a blanket.

commands.speaker: dr_carrier
commands.text: I was told my slip would show where to return it.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: It should. A book that cannot be used is merely heavy paper.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: Sit on this side while we make it useful again.
Mirel lays an empty board beneath the book. Aveline moves the chair without moving the person out of reach.
